Definition: Eliel, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliel = "my God is God" or "El is God"; 1) an ancestor of Samuel; 2) chief in David's army (might be two or three different men); 3) a Levite with David in moving the ark; 4) a chief of Manasseh; 5) two chiefs of Benjamin; 6) a chief Kohathite; 7) a Levite
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
